sentences.text: Across all their report types, Mortenson’s reports score higher than SmithGroup’s.
The most common flag in every firm’s reports is a claim that cites nothing: 72 to 79 in every 100 claims.
Mortenson’s reports score a typical 1.1 points higher than SmithGroup’s (95% interval 0.2 to 2.0; 27 and 33 reports).

Mortenson publishes more industry or market reports, which score higher across The List; comparing like with like, the gap can’t be told apart from chance (1.5 points lower to 0.4 points higher; 11 and 20 reports).
The share of Mortenson’s claims that claim more cause than the study shows trends 1.4 per 100 claims a year lower than SmithGroup’s (0.4 to 2.6).
